global_style.art_style: Fast-paced cinematic horror movie recap using photorealistic recreations of iconic scenes from IT (2017). Every beat must have a distinct composition, camera angle, character action or story moment. Target approximately 2–3 seconds per visual beat. Use realistic 1980s American locations, authentic film-inspired costumes, detailed human expressions, practical horror makeup, dramatic lighting, atmospheric fog, rain, shadows and cinematic depth. Pennywise must maintain his recognizable 2017 appearance in every shot: white clown makeup, orange-red hair, yellowish eyes, sinister smile and antique grey-white clown costume with orange-red pom-poms. Keep all recurring characters visually consistent. The hand-drawn stickman presenter has a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs and a small red bow tie. Include him selectively at the edge of shots, introducing characters, pointing at clues or reacting to scares. Never let him obscure the realistic movie action. Use occasional subtle red arrows, circles and short labels for explanations. Do not reuse the same still image for consecutive beats. Every beat represents a new visual moment, not a static slideshow.
global_style.negative_prompt: Cartoon environments, anime, vector illustrations of movie characters, childish visuals, generic horror stock images, repeated compositions, static character poses, inconsistent faces, changing costumes, inconsistent Pennywise makeup, modern cars, modern clothing, bright cheerful lighting, excessive gore, graphic injuries, blurry faces, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, text artifacts, watermarks, logos, stickman covering the main action.

host.label: Stickman Presenter
host.visual_dna: A consistent hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black line-art limbs and a small red bow tie. Simple clean design, expressive gestures and poses. Maintain identical proportions and appearance in every appearance.

derry.label: Derry Town
derry.visual_dna: A small American town in 1989, with authentic late-1980s architecture, suburban houses, telephone poles, empty roads, old shops, gloomy skies and unsettling quiet streets. Realistic cinematic atmosphere inspired by IT (2017).

georgie.label: Georgie Denbrough
georgie.visual_dna: A young boy with short brown hair wearing a bright yellow raincoat and boots. Small, innocent appearance. Consistent with Georgie's appearance in IT (2017).

bill.label: Bill Denbrough
bill.visual_dna: A teenage boy with brown hair, casual late-1980s clothing and a determined but emotionally vulnerable expression. Consistent appearance throughout the film recap.

pennywise.label: Pennywise
pennywise.visual_dna: The terrifying dancing clown from IT (2017): chalk-white face makeup, bright orange-red hair, yellowish eyes, sinister exaggerated smile, pointed teeth and an antique grey-white clown costume with orange-red pom-poms. Photorealistic horror makeup, consistent face, costume and proportions in every scene.

paper_boat.label: Paper Boat
paper_boat.visual_dna: A small folded white paper boat made by Bill for Georgie. Slightly wet and creased, with a handwritten name on it.

storm_drain.label: Storm Drain
storm_drain.visual_dna: A dark concrete roadside storm drain in a rainy 1980s American neighbourhood. Water flows through the gutter into a black opening. Realistic wet pavement, rain splashes and deep shadows.

losers.label: The Losers Club
losers.visual_dna: Seven distinct teenagers from IT (2017): Bill, Beverly, Richie, Eddie, Ben, Mike and Stanley. Each has a recognizable consistent face, hairstyle and late-1980s outfit. Keep their appearances consistent across every group shot.

richie.label: Richie Tozier
richie.visual_dna: A teenage boy with dark curly hair, glasses and casual late-1980s clothing. Energetic, sarcastic and expressive. Consistent with IT (2017).

eddie.label: Eddie Kaspbrak
eddie.visual_dna: A slim teenage boy with short brown hair, glasses and late-1980s casual clothing. Nervous, anxious expressions. Consistent with IT (2017).

beverly.label: Beverly Marsh
beverly.visual_dna: A teenage girl with long reddish hair and casual 1980s clothing. Brave, independent and emotionally vulnerable. Consistent with IT (2017).

ben.label: Ben Hanscom
ben.visual_dna: A teenage boy with brown hair and a slightly stocky build, often carrying books. Intelligent, kind and shy. Consistent with IT (2017).

henry.label: Henry Bowers
henry.visual_dna: An aggressive teenage bully with short dark hair, a threatening expression and late-1980s clothing. Consistent with IT (2017).

neibolt_house.label: Neibolt Street House
neibolt_house.visual_dna: A decaying abandoned two-storey house with broken windows, peeling paint, overgrown grass, rotten wooden floors, dark corridors and a terrifying basement. Photorealistic and consistent with the house in IT (2017).

pennywise_lair.label: Underground Lair
pennywise_lair.visual_dna: A massive underground cavern beneath Derry, with dark tunnels, old objects, floating children's belongings and an eerie supernatural atmosphere. A deep central chamber contains the floating children.

deadlights.label: Deadlights
deadlights.visual_dna: Three intensely glowing orange supernatural lights surrounded by swirling eerie energy. A disturbing otherworldly visual effect associated with Pennywise.

beats.narration_text: कहानी शुरू होती है डेरी शहर से।
beats.prompt_action: Aerial cinematic view of a quiet 1989 American town under heavy storm clouds. Rain falls over suburban houses and empty streets. Stickman presenter appears in a small corner, introducing the town.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the gloomy town of Derry in 1989.

beats.narration_text: जहाँ छोटा जॉर्जी बारिश में खेल रहा होता है।
beats.prompt_action: Georgie in his bright yellow raincoat runs along a wet suburban pavement, smiling and holding a small paper boat. Camera tracks alongside him at child height.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Georgie running through the rainy neighbourhood.

beats.narration_text: उसकी नाव पानी में बहने लगती है।
beats.prompt_action: Extreme close-up of Georgie's little white paper boat floating rapidly through a rainwater gutter. Water splashes around it as the camera follows its movement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the paper boat moving through the gutter.

beats.narration_text: और सीधे एक अँधेरे नाले में पहुँच जाती है।
beats.prompt_action: The paper boat approaches a large dark concrete storm drain. The camera moves from the wet street towards the black opening, creating a sense of dread.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Bring the boat to the storm drain entrance.

beats.narration_text: तभी अंदर से एक अजीब जोकर दिखाई देता है।
beats.prompt_action: From inside the storm drain, reveal Pennywise's pale face slowly emerging from complete darkness. His orange-red hair and yellowish eyes catch a faint reflection of daylight.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal Pennywise's face inside the drain.

beats.narration_text: वह जॉर्जी को नाव लौटाने का लालच देता है।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise crouches inside the drain and smiles unnaturally at Georgie. The boy kneels outside, looking curious. The paper boat lies between them. Faithful cinematic recreation of the iconic scene.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Pennywise pretending to be friendly with Georgie.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन अचानक वह उस पर हमला कर देता है।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise suddenly lunges out from the dark drain towards Georgie. Capture the shocking movement, Georgie's terrified reaction and splashing rainwater in one dramatic close-up. Avoid graphic injury.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the sudden attack without graphic detail.

beats.narration_text: और जॉर्जी हमेशा के लिए गायब हो जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: The abandoned yellow raincoat is no longer visible. Georgie's paper boat floats alone in the rainwater beside the empty storm drain. Slow cinematic push-in. Stickman presenter looks horrified.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End the opening with the lonely paper boat and empty drain.

beats.narration_text: कई महीने बाद भी उसका कोई पता नहीं चलता।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of an old missing-child poster featuring Georgie's photograph, stuck to a telephone pole in rainy Derry. The paper is torn and soaked.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that Georgie remains missing.

beats.narration_text: उसका भाई बिल उसे ढूँढना नहीं छोड़ता।
beats.prompt_action: Bill sits at his bedroom desk studying Georgie's photographs and drawing paper boats. His face shows grief and guilt. A dim desk lamp illuminates the room.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Bill and his emotional motivation.

beats.narration_text: डेरी में दूसरे बच्चे भी गायब होने लगते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A row of missing-child posters covers a Derry shop window. Camera tracks past the posters, revealing different children's photographs and worried family notices.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that the disappearances affect many families.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन शहर के लोग इस डर को दबाए रखते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Ordinary adults walk through the town centre ignoring the missing posters. The camera frames their indifferent faces against the unsettling background. Stickman presenter gestures towards the posters.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the town's disturbing indifference.

beats.narration_text: बिल अपने दोस्तों के साथ लूजर्स क्लब बनाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Bill, Richie, Eddie and Stanley ride their bicycles down a quiet 1980s suburban road. Camera tracks alongside them as they laugh and talk.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Bill's original group of friends.

beats.narration_text: बाद में बेन, माइक और बेवर्ली भी उनसे जुड़ते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Ben, Mike and Beverly meet the other teenagers near a neighbourhood street. Show their distinct faces and outfits as the group gradually comes together.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Complete the introduction of all seven Losers Club members.

beats.narration_text: सभी के साथ एक अजीब घटना होने लगती है।
beats.prompt_action: A close-up of a frightened teenager looking over his shoulder in a dim hallway. A disturbing shadow stretches across the wall behind him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Begin the sequence of personal supernatural encounters.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि पेनीवाइज हर बच्चे के डर का रूप ले सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise stands in a dark corridor, his sinister smile barely visible. The background contains distorted shadowy shapes representing different fears. Keep his face and costume consistent.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish Pennywise as a supernatural creature that exploits fear.

beats.narration_text: बेन को शहर के पुराने रिकॉर्ड में एक डरावना सच मिलता है।
beats.prompt_action: Ben studies old newspaper archives in a library. His finger stops at a photograph of a past disappearance. Dusty shelves and warm library lighting surround him.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Ben researching Derry's history.

beats.narration_text: हर सत्ताईस साल में बच्चों के गायब होने की घटनाएँ लौटती हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of yellowed newspaper clippings and historical photographs arranged in chronological order. Several headlines mention missing children across different decades. Stickman presenter points at the repeated dates.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Explain the recurring twenty-seven-year disappearance cycle.

beats.narration_text: उधर बेवर्ली के बाथरूम में खून से भयानक हमला होता है।
beats.prompt_action: Photorealistic recreation of Beverly's bathroom scene. Blood suddenly splatters across a white sink, mirror and bathroom walls. Beverly recoils in shock. Keep the scene frightening without graphic bodily injury.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Beverly's terrifying encounter with the supernatural blood.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन उसके पिता को वहाँ कुछ भी दिखाई नहीं देता।
beats.prompt_action: Beverly's father stands in the bathroom looking confused at the apparently clean room while Beverly stares in disbelief. Use a tense over-the-shoulder composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that the supernatural events are not visible to everyone.

beats.narration_text: बच्चों को समझ आता है कि यह सब पेनीवाइज का काम है।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers gather in a garage, examining clues and sharing their frightening experiences. Bill listens intensely while Richie and Eddie look unsettled.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the group connecting their encounters to Pennywise.

beats.narration_text: और वे उसे ढूँढने निकल पड़ते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers ride their bicycles together through a quiet Derry neighbourhood, passing old houses and telephone poles. Camera follows them from behind.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the Losers Club beginning their investigation.

beats.narration_text: उनका शक एक सुनसान घर पर जाकर रुकता है।
beats.prompt_action: The abandoned Neibolt Street house fills the frame. Broken windows, peeling paint, overgrown grass and a dark doorway. The seven teenagers stand at a distance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce the Neibolt Street house.

beats.narration_text: जहाँ उनका सामना पहली बार असली पेनीवाइज से होता है।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise's white face appears in a dark upstairs window of the abandoned house. The camera rapidly pushes towards his yellowish eyes and sinister grin. Stickman presenter points in alarm.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal Pennywise watching the children from the house.

beats.narration_text: बच्चे हिम्मत करके उस घर के अंदर जाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Bill slowly pushes open the rotten front door while the other six teenagers follow him into the dark house. The camera moves behind them through the entrance.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the group entering the abandoned house.

beats.narration_text: अंदर हर तरफ अँधेरा और अजीब आवाज़ें हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A narrow decaying hallway with peeling wallpaper, broken floorboards and flickering lights. The camera glides slowly past an open door and a moving shadow.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Build tension inside the house.

beats.narration_text: अचानक एक भयानक आकृति उनके सामने आ जाती है।
beats.prompt_action: A monstrous distorted apparition suddenly emerges from a dark room. The teenagers recoil and raise their hands defensively. Photorealistic horror makeup and dramatic shadows.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the house's frightening supernatural encounter.

beats.narration_text: और पेनीवाइज उन पर हमला करने लगता है।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise suddenly charges through the hallway towards the frightened teenagers. Capture a dynamic action frame with motion, terrified expressions and harsh overhead lighting.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Pennywise attacking the group inside the house.

beats.narration_text: सभी किसी तरह वहाँ से भाग निकलते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The teenagers sprint through the front door of the abandoned house. Bill pulls one friend forward while Richie looks back in terror. The camera follows their escape.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the Losers Club escaping from Neibolt House.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन उनका डर अभी खत्म नहीं हुआ था।
beats.prompt_action: Outside the house, the exhausted teenagers stand in the rain catching their breath. Bill looks back at the dark windows. A pale face is barely visible behind the glass.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Leave the threat unresolved and maintain suspense.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि हेनरी बोवर्स भी उन्हें लगातार परेशान कर रहा था।
beats.prompt_action: Henry Bowers confronts the Losers Club in a late-1980s street. He steps aggressively towards them while his gang stands behind him. Stickman presenter gestures towards Henry as another threat.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Introduce Henry Bowers and his gang as human antagonists.

beats.narration_text: और धीरे-धीरे सभी दोस्त एक-दूसरे से बिछड़ने लगते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers stand separated in a quiet street, arguing and looking distressed. Bill is visibly frustrated while the others turn away. The frame emphasizes their growing separation.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the group beginning to fall apart.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन जब बेवर्ली गायब हो जाती है, बिल फिर सबको बुलाता है।
beats.prompt_action: Bill urgently uses a late-1980s telephone in his home, trying to contact his friends. His face shows panic and determination.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Bill bringing the group back together after Beverly disappears.

beats.narration_text: उसे पता है कि पेनीवाइज उसे अपने ठिकाने पर ले गया है।
beats.prompt_action: A dark underground tunnel beneath Derry, with old pipes, wet stone walls and a faint orange glow far ahead. The camera moves deeper into the passage.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the underground route to Pennywise's lair.

beats.narration_text: बिल अपने दोस्तों के साथ नीचे उतर जाता है।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers carefully descend a rough underground passage carrying flashlights. Their beams illuminate damp walls and scattered debris. Bill leads the group.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the Losers Club entering the underground tunnels.

beats.narration_text: वहाँ उन्हें गायब हुए बच्चे हवा में तैरते दिखाई देते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A huge underground cavern reveals several unconscious children floating motionless in the air. The Losers Club stands below, staring upward in horror. Photorealistic supernatural effects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the floating missing children in Pennywise's lair.

beats.narration_text: और बीच में बेवर्ली भी उसी हालत में फँसी होती है।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of Beverly floating unconscious among the other children, her long reddish hair drifting slightly. The eerie underground lights illuminate her face.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal Beverly among the floating children.

beats.narration_text: तभी बिल को जॉर्जी जैसा दिखने वाला चेहरा नज़र आता है।
beats.prompt_action: Bill sees a child resembling Georgie standing in the underground chamber. The child looks at him with an unsettling familiar expression. Bill's face shows shock and grief.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Pennywise exploiting Bill's longing for Georgie.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन वह समझ जाता है कि यह पेनीवाइज का धोखा है।
beats.prompt_action: The apparent Georgie illusion changes into Pennywise's terrifying white clown face. Bill steps backwards, realizing the deception. Use a dramatic supernatural transformation without cartoon effects.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Reveal the illusion as another manipulation by Pennywise.

beats.narration_text: अब सातों दोस्त मिलकर उससे लड़ने का फैसला करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers stand shoulder to shoulder in the underground cavern, facing Pennywise in the distance. Bill takes a step forward while the others gather behind him. Stickman presenter raises a fist.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the Losers Club united and ready to fight.

beats.narration_text: इस बार वे भागते नहीं, बल्कि उसका सामना करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Bill advances towards Pennywise with determination. The clown stands across the cavern, towering over the teenagers. Dramatic low-angle cinematic composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Bill confronting Pennywise instead of running away.

beats.narration_text: रिची, एडी और बाकी दोस्त भी हमला शुरू कर देते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Richie, Eddie, Ben, Mike, Stanley and Beverly's friends attack Pennywise from different directions in a fast-paced underground battle. Capture a dynamic wide frame with believable movement.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the group fighting Pennywise together.

beats.narration_text: पेनीवाइज अब पहले की तरह ताकतवर नहीं दिखता।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of Pennywise looking increasingly frightened and angry. His sinister grin disappears as he recoils from the teenagers. His recognizable clown appearance remains unchanged.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Pennywise losing confidence and control.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि बच्चे अब उससे डरना बंद कर चुके होते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The Losers Club stand together facing Pennywise without retreating. Their frightened expressions transform into determination. Camera slowly pushes towards their united faces.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize that their courage weakens Pennywise.

beats.narration_text: वे उसे बुरी तरह हराकर पीछे हटने पर मजबूर कर देते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Pennywise stumbles backwards towards a dark opening in the cavern as the teenagers stand their ground. The orange supernatural light fades around him. No graphic gore.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Pennywise defeated and retreating into darkness.

beats.narration_text: बिल अपने दोस्तों के साथ बेवर्ली को बचा लेता है।
beats.prompt_action: Beverly is safely back with the Losers Club. Bill and the others gather around her as she regains consciousness. Their faces show relief and exhaustion.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show Beverly rescued and reunited with her friends.

beats.narration_text: सभी बच्चे उस खौफनाक जगह से बाहर निकल आते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The seven teenagers climb out of the underground passage into daylight. They are tired, muddy and relieved. Camera follows them from behind towards the bright exit.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the group's escape from the underground lair.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन वे जानते हैं कि यह कहानी अभी खत्म नहीं हुई।
beats.prompt_action: A final dark view into the abandoned underground tunnel. Deep inside, a faint pair of yellowish eyes seems to watch from the darkness. Slow cinematic push-in, then fade to black.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Leave an ominous hint that Pennywise may return.

beats.narration_text: जाने से पहले सातों दोस्त खून की कसम खाते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: Close-up of the seven teenagers joining their hands together in a solemn blood oath. Their hands are shown with a small symbolic cut, without graphic detail.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the symbolic blood oath.

beats.narration_text: अगर पेनीवाइज लौटा, तो वे फिर साथ लड़ेंगे।
beats.prompt_action: The seven members of the Losers Club stand together in a dramatic late-afternoon group portrait. Bill looks determined, Beverly stands confidently and the others remain close together. Stickman presenter stands at the edge, giving a final approving gesture.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with the group's promise to face Pennywise together again.
